telemetry.interpretation: The GPU receives intermittent work while the Host remains on the per-surface CPU pose path. This run does not exercise the resource/instance architecture.

root_cause.finding: L4D2 directly invokes CModelRender::DrawModelExecute internally. Replacing only the IVModelRender vtable entry misses those direct calls. The l4d2-rtx reference resolves slot 19 and detours the function entry instead.

exit.assessment: The v47 vtable entry remained pointed at Client code during unload and is a material dangling-callback risk. Named frames alone do not prove the unique caller.

v48_actions: Detour the DrawModelExecute function entry instead of replacing only slot 19.
Detach the model hook before Bridge Client unload.
Record function-entry calls, valid captures and rejected captures.
Keep unscoped performance draws on the native path so CPU pose cannot conceal a hook failure.
